title: Void Infuser
text: Craft at an Arcane Assembly Bench.
Each operation takes ten seconds and one point of spatial energy. The infuser holds up to 64 points. See Spatial Energy Materials for item and fluid inputs.

Infuse Mirror Rock into Void-Touched Mirror Rock, Light Condensate into Shadow Rock, slime balls into ender pearls and obsidian into crying obsidian. All temporal silts become rotted, and all saplings become Shadow Saplings.
Any music disc can be converted into a Po Sui Shi Jie disc, playable in a jukebox.
